selection.rule: qualified = (>=1 locked-target real BlockScore) AND (scores >= FSM) AND (us drops <= FSM) AND (all scores traceable); then sort by more target scores, fewer drops, more training steps

block_off_semantics: BlockOff is emitted by the referee only when a block exits without a valid scoring owner.

freeze_record.note: freeze record written before any final_holdout_v2 run
